root_cause.text: The error path in `ath12k_mac_op_change_vif_links()` fails to clean up the `ahvif->links_map` entry when an arvif is initialized but not created (`arvif->is_created == false`), leaving a stale mapping that causes conflicts when the same link ID is reused.
root_cause.evidence: The patch shows that link deletion only executes when `arvif->is_created` is true (the condition `if (!arvif->is_created) continue;` skips cleanup). When MLO connection preparation fails before arvif creation, the initialized but uncreated arvif remains mapped in `ahvif->links_map`. The fix adds `ath12k_mac_unassign_link_vif(arvif)` before the continue statement to clear this stale mapping, preventing the WARN_ON that occurs when a new arvif with the same link ID attempts to use the already-mapped entry.

intent_record.intent_summary: Ensure proper cleanup of unassigned link VIFs when skipping uncreated virtual interfaces to prevent resource leaks.
intent_record.what: Added a call to `ath12k_mac_unassign_link_vif(arvif)` before the `continue` statement in the conditional block that checks `if (!arvif->is_created)`. The statement is now wrapped in braces to accommodate the additional function call.
intent_record.how: When a virtual interface has not been created (`!arvif->is_created`), the code now explicitly unassigns the link VIF before skipping to the next iteration. This ensures proper cleanup of the virtual interface's link state before continuing, preventing potential resource leaks or inconsistent state where a VIF link remains assigned despite not being fully created.

bic_trace_step.reason: The commit introduces a fix for the vulnerability described in the root cause. The vulnerable construct was the missing cleanup of `ahvif->links_map` entry when `arvif->is_created == false` during link removal. The fix adds a new loop in `ath12k_mac_op_change_vif_links()` that iterates through links to be removed (lines 3629-3644). Critically, it includes the check `if (!arvif->is_created) continue;` (line 3635-3636) which skips the cleanup calls (`ath12k_mac_remove_link_interface()` and `ath12k_mac_unassign_link_vif()`) only when the arvif was not created. This prevents attempting to clean up non-existent resources. Additionally, the commit removes the unconditional cleanup from `ath12k_mac_op_unassign_vif_chanctx()` (lines 9447-9450 deleted), moving it to the proper location in `change_vif_links()` where it can be conditionally applied. This ensures that stale `ahvif->links_map` entries are properly cleaned up when links are removed, fixing the vulnerability.
